title: SecurityFindingsReport
description: Machine-readable security audit findings with SARIF compatibility, attack chain composition, compliance mapping, and confidence calibration.

priorAuditDate.description: For differential audits: date of the prior audit

diffScope.description: For differential audits: git range or file list scanned

scannersUsed.description: CLI tools detected and executed during the audit (e.g., semgrep, trivy, gitleaks)

confidence.description: High = verified via tool output or PoC. Medium = code pattern match, untested. Low = theoretical, requires human review.

triageEvidence.description: Documents the 4-Point Triage Gate evaluation for this finding

sourceToSinkTrace.description: Description of the data flow path from source to sink

productionContext.description: True if the code is in a production path (not test/mock/build)

mitigatingControlsAbsent.description: True if no upstream framework controls mitigate this

exploitPrerequisites.description: What conditions must hold for the exploit to work

framework.description: e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001

control.description: e.g., PCI-DSS 6.5.1, SOC 2 CC6.1, GDPR Article 32

pocFile.description: Relative path to the PoC test script in .security-audit/security-tests/

verificationCommand.description: Exact command to re-run the PoC test

detectedBy.description: Whether this finding came from LLM reasoning, a CLI scanner, DAST testing, or a combination

attackChains.description: Composite multi-finding exploit narratives that chain individual findings into realistic attack paths

title.description: e.g., 'Unauthenticated Admin Access via SSRF + Hardcoded Key'

findingIds.description: Ordered list of SEC-XXX IDs that compose this chain

narrative.description: Step-by-step description of how the chain is exploited

compositeImpact.description: The combined impact, which is often worse than any individual finding

confidenceDistribution.description: Summary of finding confidence levels across the audit
